review.intent_summary: Limit extreme observations’ influence on fitted expectations and future seasonal references while preserving their observed values and anomaly evidence.

criteria.criterion: Robust seasonal references reduce the influence of an extreme prior matching seasonal value.
Training and calibration diagnostics identify excluded extreme observations.
An extreme evaluated sample remains evidence while its expected value is used in future references.
Callers can choose include mode to retain raw extreme observations and inspect the resulting echo behavior.

verification_evidence: Manual source review traced separate observed and reference values, exclusion diagnostics, and expected-value replacement.
Inspected tests asserting trimmed-reference invariance, training/calibration exclusions, preserved anomaly triggers, and robust versus include seasonal echoes.
remaining_gaps: Automated checks were inspected but not rerun during this review.
